fullDescription: A high-conversion full-bleed end-of-page CTA band for an AI product-design tool (Solra) on a single warm coral-to-amber SUNSET gradient: a sticky frosted nav, a thin neutral context strip that names the funnel step ('Prompt library, 12,000+ designs'), then the gradient band carrying an ink eyebrow pill, a giant two-line 'Stop browsing. Start shipping.' display headline, a short subhead, a solid-ink primary + cream ghost button pair and a three-item trust line. The whole point is LEGIBILITY: contrast is bought with dark INK text + ink/cream buttons (never white-on-yellow), plus a depth-bloom + grain + seam recipe that keeps the gradient from looking flat. Plus Jakarta Sans, Phosphor icons, warm and decisive.

structured.summary: A high-conversion, full-bleed END-OF-PAGE CTA band for an AI product-design tool (Solra), built around one signature move: a single warm CORAL-to-AMBER sunset gradient section that carries a giant centered display headline, a short subhead, a primary + secondary button pair and a quiet trust line, with EVERY element painted in near-black ink (not white) so it stays legible against the bright gradient (the 'legibility-fixed' point). The page stacks as a sticky frosted nav, then a thin neutral 'context strip' that names where you are in the funnel ('Prompt library, 12,000+ designs' eyebrow + a one-line 'you've browsed, one step left' setup), then THE CTA BAND: a relative overflow-hidden .sunset section (a coral #ff6b4a -> amber #ffb020 linear gradient overlaid by two radial sun-glow stops), decorated with two big blurred white/peach depth blooms, a faint white polka grain and a soft top seam that fades the neutral strip into the gradient. Centered inside a max-w-[1180px] container it stacks: an ink pill eyebrow ('From prompt to pixels'), a 44px -> 76px font-extrabold ink headline ('Stop browsing. / Start shipping.'), a 16 -> 19px ink/90 subhead, a button row (a solid ink 'Generate my first design' pill with cream text + a trailing arrow, beside a cream-filled ink-bordered 'See it on the canvas' ghost pill with a play glyph), and a wrap of three ink/85 trust items (No credit card / Works in your coding agent / 57k builders). The reusable signature is the LEGIBILITY-FIXED SUNSET CTA system: a coral->amber gradient band where contrast is bought with dark INK text + ink buttons (never low-contrast white-on-yellow), plus the depth-bloom + grain + seam recipe that keeps the gradient from ever looking flat. Plus Jakarta Sans throughout (tight negative tracking), Phosphor (iconify) icons, mood warm/optimistic/energetic/decisive.

style.description: A warm, optimistic, energetic LIGHT CTA aesthetic anchored on a single full-bleed CORAL-to-AMBER sunset gradient band, set off by a calm neutral sand frame above it. Register a small custom Tailwind palette: coral #ff6b4a, amber #ffb020, ink #2a1306 (a very dark warm brown, almost black), cream #fff6ee, sand #fbf2ea; the page body is sand #fbf2ea with ink #2a1306 text. The signature surface is the .sunset gradient: a base linear-gradient(132deg, #ff6b4a 0%, #ff8038 44%, #ffa829 78%, #ffb020 100%) OVERLAID by two radial sun-glow stops (a bright amber radial-gradient(120% 140% at 84% -12%, rgba(255,186,48,0.98)->0 at 54%) in the top-right and a deeper coral radial-gradient(130% 140% at 6% 118%, rgba(255,79,46,0.78)->0 at 52%) in the bottom-left), so the band reads like a real sunset glowing from the corners. The CRITICAL contrast rule (the 'legibility-fixed' POV): on this bright gradient, do NOT use white or pale text; paint nearly everything in ink #2a1306 and its alphas (the headline at full ink for ~9-12:1, the subhead ink/90, the trust line + eyebrow + icons ink/85-100, the divider pips ink/30) so contrast stays AA+ across both the bright amber and the deep coral corners. Depth + texture come from three CSS layers inside the band: two big pointer-events-none blurred BLOOMS (.bloom-a a white-core radial at top-right, .bloom-b a peach #ffc980 radial at bottom-left, both blur-2xl at ~80-90% opacity) for soft glow, and a .grain polka wash (radial-gradient rgba(255,255,255,0.10) 1px dots on a 22px grid at opacity-60) so the gradient never looks flat; a pointer-events-none top SEAM (an inset-x-0 top-0 h-20 bg-gradient-to-b from-sand/55 to-transparent) softly melts the neutral context strip into the band. Buttons buy contrast with solidity: the PRIMARY is a solid bg-ink rounded-full pill with cream text and a heavy ink drop-shadow (shadow 0 14px 34px -12px rgba(42,19,6,0.6)); the SECONDARY is a cream-filled rounded-full pill with a 2px ink/85 border and ink text; both lift translateY(-2px) and deepen their shadow on hover (.btn-primary / .btn-ghost transitions, cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1)). The nav is a .scrim frosted bar (bg rgba(251,242,234,0.78) + backdrop-blur saturate(150%) blur(12px)) over a border-ink/10 hairline, with the same solid-ink rounded-full 'Start free' pill. The context-strip eyebrow + the band eyebrow are rounded-full pill chips (a white/70 ink-bordered one on sand, an ink/8 ink-bordered one on the gradient). Type is Plus Jakarta Sans only (weights 400-800 + italic 500) with tight negative letter-spacing helpers (.tight -0.02em, .tighter -0.035em, .tightest -0.045em) leaning on extrabold 800 for the headline + eyebrows. Icons are Phosphor via iconify (sun-horizon-fill logo, sparkle-fill, arrow-right-bold, play-circle, check-circle-fill, terminal-window-fill, users-three-fill). ::selection is ink bg / cream text. Mood: warm, sunny, optimistic, energetic and decisive (a 'stop browsing, start shipping' end-of-page push), never washed-out or low-contrast.
style.prompt: Design a warm, optimistic, energetic LIGHT end-of-page CTA section for an AI product-design tool, anchored on ONE full-bleed CORAL-to-AMBER sunset gradient band that sits below a calm neutral sand frame. Register a small Tailwind palette: coral #ff6b4a, amber #ffb020, ink #2a1306 (a very dark warm brown), cream #fff6ee, sand #fbf2ea; make the body bg sand #fbf2ea with ink #2a1306 text. Use Plus Jakarta Sans only (Google Fonts, weights 400;500;600;700;800 + italic 500, mapped to fontFamily.sans) with tight negative letter-spacing helpers (.tight -0.02em, .tighter -0.035em, .tightest -0.045em), and Phosphor icons via iconify (ph:sun-horizon-fill, ph:sparkle-fill, ph:arrow-right-bold, ph:play-circle, ph:check-circle-fill, ph:terminal-window-fill, ph:users-three-fill). The whole point is a LEGIBILITY-FIXED sunset CTA: build the .sunset surface as a base linear-gradient(132deg, #ff6b4a 0%, #ff8038 44%, #ffa829 78%, #ffb020 100%) OVERLAID by two radial sun-glow stops (a bright amber radial-gradient(120% 140% at 84% -12%, rgba(255,186,48,0.98) 0%, transparent 54%) top-right + a deep coral radial-gradient(130% 140% at 6% 118%, rgba(255,79,46,0.78) 0%, transparent 52%) bottom-left). On that bright gradient do NOT use white text: paint EVERY element in ink #2a1306 and its alphas (the headline full ink, the subhead ink/90, the eyebrow + trust line + icons ink/85-100, the divider pips ink/30) so contrast holds AA+ on both the amber and coral corners. Add depth + texture purely in CSS: two big pointer-events-none blurred blooms (a white-core radial .bloom-a top-right, a peach #ffc980 radial .bloom-b bottom-left, both blur-2xl at ~80-90% opacity), a .grain polka wash (radial-gradient rgba(255,255,255,0.10) 1px dots on a 22px grid, opacity-60), and a pointer-events-none top seam (inset-x-0 top-0 h-20 bg-gradient-to-b from-sand/55 to-transparent) that melts the neutral strip above into the band. Buy button contrast with solidity, not color: make the PRIMARY a solid bg-ink rounded-full pill with cream text + a trailing ph:arrow-right-bold and a heavy ink drop-shadow (0 14px 34px -12px rgba(42,19,6,0.6)); make the SECONDARY a cream-filled rounded-full pill with a 2px ink/85 border, ink text + a ph:play-circle glyph; both lift translateY(-2px) and deepen their shadow on hover (cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1)). Stack the page as: a .scrim frosted sticky nav (bg rgba(251,242,234,0.78) + backdrop-blur saturate(150%) blur(12px), a sunset-tile sun-horizon logo + 'Solra' wordmark, Canvas/Library/Pricing/Docs/Changelog links, a Log in link + a solid-ink 'Start free' pill); a thin neutral sand CONTEXT STRIP (a centered white/70 ink-bordered rounded-full eyebrow pill 'PROMPT LIBRARY · 12,000+ DESIGNS' with a coral sparkle + a one-line max-w-[560px] ink/80 setup line); then THE CTA BAND. Center the band content in a max-w-[1180px] container, py-24 -> sm:py-36, stacked: an ink pill eyebrow ('FROM PROMPT TO PIXELS', ink/8 fill + ink/25 border + a tiny ink dot), a tightest font-extrabold ink HEADLINE at text-[44px] -> sm:text-[76px] leading-[0.98] ('Stop browsing.' / 'Start shipping.' on two lines), a max-w-[520px] font-semibold ink/90 SUBHEAD at 16 -> 19px ('Describe any screen and watch Solra draft the UI, components, and full flows on an infinite canvas. Your first design is one prompt away.'), the BUTTON ROW (the solid-ink primary 'Generate my first design' + the cream ghost 'See it on the canvas', stacking full-width below sm), and a flex-wrap TRUST LINE of three ink/85 items separated by thin ink/30 pips (a check-circle 'No credit card', a terminal-window 'Works in your coding agent', a users-three '57k builders'). Lean on Plus Jakarta Sans extrabold 800 for the headline + eyebrows; keep the ::selection ink bg / cream text. Everything must reflow cleanly to mobile (the nav center links + Log in hide, the buttons stack full-width, the headline drops to ~44px, the trust pips hide, no horizontal overflow at 390px). Mood: warm, sunny, optimistic, energetic and decisive, never washed-out or low-contrast. Zero em-dashes anywhere.
style.fonts:
Plus Jakarta Sans only (Google Fonts, family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;0,800;1,500, mapped as Tailwind fontFamily.sans with fallbacks system-ui, sans-serif, rendered -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased + text-rendering:optimizeLegibility), a clean geometric humanist sans driven HARD on its extrabold 800 weight with tight negative letter-spacing (helpers .tight -0.02em, .tighter -0.035em, .tightest -0.045em). The DISPLAY HEADLINE is the anchor: .tightest font-extrabold (800) leading-[0.98] at a responsive clamp text-[44px] -> sm:text-[76px], full ink #2a1306, broken across two lines via a sm-only
('Stop browsing.' / 'Start shipping.'), max-w-[14ch]. The SUBHEAD is .tight font-semibold (600) text-[16px] -> sm:text-[19px] leading-relaxed ink/90 max-w-[520px]. Both EYEBROWS are uppercase font-extrabold (800) / font-bold (700) text-[11.5px] with wide tracking ([0.16em] on the context strip, [0.18em] on the band), the strip one ink/75 and the band one full ink. The TRUST LINE is .tight font-semibold (600) text-[13px] ink/85. NAV: the 'Solra' wordmark is text-[16px] font-bold (700) .tighter ink; nav links are text-[13.5px] font-semibold (600) ink/80; the Log in link + the 'Start free' / nav CTA copy are text-[13.5px] font-semibold (600). BUTTONS: the primary + secondary labels are text-[16px] font-bold (700) (cream on the ink primary, ink on the cream ghost). The context-strip setup line is text-[14.5px] -> sm:text-[15.5px] font-medium (500) leading-relaxed ink/80. The italic 500 is loaded but unused in the band. All UI runs in Plus Jakarta Sans, no second family.
style.palette: sand #fbf2ea is the page body + the calm context-strip frame above the band + the nav scrim base (at 0.78 alpha) + the top-seam fade source. cream #fff6ee is the inverted text on the ink primary button + the secondary button fill + the ::selection text. ink #2a1306 (a very dark warm brown, near-black) is the workhorse: ALL headline + body text, the eyebrow + trust copy, the icons, the 'Solra' wordmark, the solid primary + nav 'Start free' button fills, the secondary button's 2px border + text, the divider pips (at /30) and the ::selection bg, plus its alphas (text ink/80-/90, border ink/8-/25, trust ink/85, hairlines ink/10). The HERO SURFACE is the warm sunset: coral #ff6b4a + amber #ffb020 anchor a base linear-gradient(132deg, #ff6b4a -> #ff8038 -> #ffa829 -> #ffb020) overlaid by two radial sun-glow stops (a bright amber rgba(255,186,48,0.98) top-right glow, a deeper coral rgba(255,79,46,0.78) bottom-left glow). coral #ff6b4a also tints the small sparkle icon in the context-strip eyebrow + the sunset logo tile. The depth blooms are a white-core radial (rgba(255,255,255,0.42)) and a peach rgba(255,201,128,0.55) radial; the grain dots are rgba(255,255,255,0.10). The deliberate discipline: the bright coral->amber gradient is the ONLY saturated surface, and contrast on it is bought entirely with DARK INK (never white) text + ink/cream buttons, so the band is loud and legible at once. No blues, no greys beyond ink alphas, no dark mode.

layout_and_structure.description:
A full-bleed light marketing page tail, content centered inside a mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 (sm:px-8) container, stacked top to bottom as: (1) a sticky frosted .scrim nav, (2) a thin neutral sand CONTEXT STRIP, and (3) THE FULL-BLEED SUNSET CTA BAND (the centerpiece). The defining structural move is the CTA BAND: a relative overflow-hidden .sunset
whose gradient surface is decorated by four absolute pointer-events-none layers (a top-right white .bloom-a, a bottom-left peach .bloom-b, an inset-0 .grain polka wash, and an inset-x-0 top-0 h-20 from-sand/55 top SEAM) and whose foreground is a relative max-w-[1180px] flex flex-col items-center justify-center py-24 (sm:py-36) text-center stack: an ink pill EYEBROW, the big two-line ink HEADLINE, an ink/90 SUBHEAD, a BUTTON ROW (flex-col -> sm:flex-row) and a flex-wrap TRUST LINE. Above it, the CONTEXT STRIP is a bg-sand border-b border-ink/8 section with a centered max-w-[1180px] py-10 (sm:py-14) stack: a white/70 rounded-full eyebrow pill ('PROMPT LIBRARY · 12,000+ DESIGNS' with a coral sparkle) over a max-w-[560px] ink/80 setup line. The NAV is a sticky top-0 z-50 .scrim header with an inner mx-auto flex h-16 max-w-[1180px] items-center justify-between px-6 (sm:px-8) row: a logo (a sunset-gradient rounded tile + a 'Solra' wordmark), a hidden md:flex center link group (Canvas / Library / Pricing / Docs / Changelog), and a right cluster (a hidden sm:inline 'Log in' link + a solid-ink rounded-full 'Start free' pill). Everything reflows to a single column on mobile: the nav center links hide below md and 'Log in' below sm, the headline drops to ~44px (the
hides below sm), the button row stacks full-width below sm, the trust pips hide below sm, and there is no horizontal overflow at 390px.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top-0 z-50 w-full <header> with a .scrim frosted fill (background rgba(251,242,234,0.78) + backdrop-filter saturate(150%) blur(12px), with -webkit- prefix) over a border-b border-ink/10 hairline. Inner nav = mx-auto flex h-16 max-w-[1180px] items-center justify-between px-6 (sm:px-8). LEFT: a logo link (flex items-center gap-2.5) = a flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-[9px] .sunset (the coral->amber gradient) text-white shadow-sm tile holding an iconify ph:sun-horizon-fill at text-[15px], beside a text-[16px] font-bold .tighter text-ink 'Solra' wordmark. CENTER (hidden below md, md:flex items-center gap-8, text-[13.5px] font-semibold text-ink/80): five .nav-link links 'Canvas' / 'Library' / 'Pricing' / 'Docs' / 'Changelog', each hover:text-ink (transition color .15s). RIGHT (flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-3): a 'Log in' text link (hidden below sm, text-[13.5px] font-semibold text-ink/80 .nav-link px-2) and a 'Start free' primary pill (an href='#cta' rounded-full bg-ink px-4 py-[7px] text-[13.5px] font-semibold text-cream .btn-primary that lifts translateY(-2px) + deepens its shadow on hover).

A bg-sand border-b border-ink/8 <section> with an inner mx-auto max-w-[1180px] px-6 (sm:px-8) py-10 (sm:py-14) text-center stack. First an EYEBROW PILL: an inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-ink/15 bg-white/70 px-3.5 py-1.5 chip holding an iconify ph:sparkle-fill at text-[14px] text-coral + a text-[11.5px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.16em] text-ink/75 label 'Prompt library · 12,000+ designs' (use a middot · between the two parts). Then a mx-auto mt-5 max-w-[560px] text-[14.5px] (sm:text-[15.5px]) leading-relaxed font-medium text-ink/80 .tight SETUP line: 'You have browsed the gallery, copied a few prompts, and seen what the canvas can do. There is one step left.'
